symptoms: 'Retention Hook Frame and TTS Speed', 'Hook Experiment E2E hook-on', 'Hook Experiment E2E hook-off' failing uncaught at video/video_engine.py create_scene -> fetch_pexels_video -> search_pexels_candidates
search_pexels_candidates() raised a bare untyped RuntimeError for every HTTP failure kind (429, 5xx, other), so callers could not distinguish provider-availability failure from query-quality failure

fetch_pexels_video()'s fallback-query loop and fetch_hook_pexels_video()'s query loop had no try/except around the search call, so the exception propagated out of create_scene() and killed the whole scene

an existing multi-provider fallback (ci_video_provider_hotfix.py, backed by video/video_providers.py's Pexels+Wikimedia+Pixabay pool) already existed in the real production hotfix chain, but retention_e2e.yml and hook_experiment_e2e.yml each hard-coded their own abbreviated hotfix list that never applied it

root_cause.summary: search_pexels_candidates() had no error classification and its two call sites had no exception handling, so an HTTP 429 (an availability failure) crashed create_scene() outright instead of triggering the multi-provider fallback that already existed elsewhere in the codebase but was never wired into these two E2E workflows.

evidence.note: PR body documents the original crash location (video/video_engine.py:543) and the three compounding causes; this is an agent-authored PR description, not a raw log capture -- see caveat below.
search_pexels_candidates() prior to the fix: single untyped RuntimeError for every HTTP failure kind.
pre-existing multi-provider fallback that was not applied by the two failing workflows before this fix.

fix.summary: Added typed ProviderRateLimitedError (HTTP 429) / ProviderTransientError (5xx/timeout/network) exceptions to search_pexels_candidates(); wrapped both call sites (fetch_pexels_video, fetch_hook_pexels_video) in try/except that breaks the fallback-query loop immediately on either typed exception (bounded to at most one Pexels call per outage) rather than storming it with different queries; threaded a caller-owned provider_state dict through ci_video_provider_hotfix.py's search_video_candidates()/fetch_video() so once Pexels is marked unavailable in one fetch pass, later fallback queries in that same pass skip straight to Wikimedia Commons/Pixabay; added the missing ci_video_provider_hotfix.py step to retention_e2e.yml and hook_experiment_e2e.yml so these E2E jobs actually exercise the multi-provider pool instead of the single-provider legacy path.

relationships.note: INC-002 is a regression introduced while fixing this incident, within the same PR #436.
